QuestInfo.name: Worried About Alicia
QuestInfo.0: You need to ask Hazelle what Alicia is doing, but the soldier is incredibly determined to get rations.
QuestInfo.1: Alicia is heading to the mountain to search for animals for the Ark. Before you can follow her, you meet a soldier who asks for your assistance in securing rations.
QuestInfo.2: Alicia went to the mountain to search for animals for the Ark. Before you could follow her, you met a soldier, who asked for your assistance in securing rations.
